description: isometric pixel art small town for a trucking tycoon game map, on a transparent background, seen from the high angle of an isometric tycoon map: a small industrial town in the northeast: a red-brick mill with a smokestack by the river, a rail yard, row houses on a hill, a church with twin spires, a highway overpass, a two-lane highway passing through with a tiny semi truck, highly detailed HD painterly pixel art shading with layered depth, warm late-afternoon light, saturated palette, the whole town fitting inside the frame with clear space around it, standing on flat ground that fades out to transparency at its edges with no platform, block or base edge under it, never any words, letters or labels
